label: GO step after an unrewarded visit to S2 (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was unrewarded (in_rew 0), and never when the previous trial reached S1: in every activation where the previous state is known, that state was S2 (prev_state != 1 also lets in window-first trials, where the previous state is outside the window). It also never fires after episode trial ~70, and it is most frequent in the first few trials. With these conditions recall is about 1.0 and mass recall about 1.0 on dev, but precision is only about 0.23: it fires on roughly a quarter of qualifying GO steps. Adding a value-head band (7.5 to 8.1), the upcoming choice (action 1 or 2, choice sign), or the hidden good state did not raise precision above 0.25, so what decides whether it fires within the condition is not captured. Within the condition it leans toward switch trials (stay=0 lift 4.3x) and trials where good = S1. It is silent on all D1 and D2 steps, after rewarded trials, and after unrewarded S1 visits. The predicate uses only observed variables.
